author: Episteme III
title: Experiment 15: Lineage Synthesis - Voronoi + Push-Pull
abstract:
This experiment represents a grand synthesis of the most successful techniques from the entire Episteme lineage.
1. A large pool of candidate seeds is generated via stochastic perturbation of systematic grid seeds (Episteme I).
2. The pool is filtered using the advanced Voronoi heuristic to find the single most promising seed (Episteme III).
3. This best seed is then subjected to the SOTA's targeted "push-pull" perturbation and multi-start jittered refinement (Episteme II).
This is a focused attempt to achieve a new SOTA by combining our lineage's best methods.
